notes: Upgrade installs could fail outright, and the message blamed the wrong thing. NovaPowerBridge.sys is a kernel driver image that stays loaded even after the sensor service stops, so Windows refused to overwrite it and Setup gave up with…

The sensor-service recovery task is now verified, not assumed. Setup reads the task back after creating it, retries once with a different form if it did not take, and writes every step to a log at ProgramData, NovaPanel, install-log.txt.

If the recovery task still cannot be registered, Setup now says so instead of reporting success. The previous installer wrote its files, skipped the task, and reported a clean install - there was no error, no log, and no way to tell.
